none: PAS NLM-F85D04: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Fridaythorpe
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Inscription present but illegible. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: 12
